description:
If you want to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
https://littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

This week, I am taking some time off in a Tibetan Valley of northern Yunnan. Tibetan culture ranges much further than Tibet Autonomous Region. In fact, there are plenty of Tibetan villages in Yunnan. The one I am in right now is called Deqin, a valley along the Langcan River, the upper stream of the Mekong River that fuels most of Laos, Cambodia and Vietnam. Join me on this adventure in northern Yunnan 🇨🇳
